rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that fails to interest or inspire people.

example.english: This proposal is uninspiring, so nobody wants to take part.
example.traditional: 呢個提議冇乜吸引力，大家都唔想參加。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 mou5 mat1 kap1 jan5 lik6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the uninspiring thing is specifically dull or boring.

example.english: The film is uninspiring, and I fell asleep after watching it for a while.
example.traditional: 呢套戲太沉悶，我睇咗一陣就瞓着。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 taai3 cam4 mun6 ngo5 tai2 zo2 jat1 zan6 zau6 fan3 zoek6

rows.jyutping: ling6 jan4 tai4 bat1 hei2 ging3
rows.note: Use this for a person, activity, or idea that fails to motivate people or get them enthusiastic.

example.english: A three-hour morning meeting is really uninspiring.
example.traditional: 朝早開會開足三個鐘，真係令人提不起勁。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 hoi1 wui2 hoi1 zuk1 saam1 go3 zung1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tai4 bat1 hei2 ging3
